feeds.title: Namibia Economist
feeds.description: The Namibia Economist enjoys wide popularity as a specialist business publication. In the local market, it is firmly entrenched as the leading public source of business intelligence. The name Namibia Economist has become synonymous with reliable business reporting and on the marketing side, it is widely regarded as an effective medium to communicate messages to the top echelons of both private and public sectors.

feeds.title: Namibian News Digest
feeds.description: The Namibian News Digest provides news from all sectors around the Africa region.

feeds.title: Informanté
feeds.description: Namibia's biggest news platform. Our mission is to become the most competitive newspaper in media communication in Namibia, by being an efficient newsgathering production entity.

feeds.title: Windhoek Observer
feeds.description: The Windhoek Observer is an English-language weekly newspaper, published in Namibia by Paragon Investment Holding. It is the country's oldest and largest circulating weekly.

feeds.title: Namibia Daily News
feeds.description: Namibia Daily is the first online newspaper in Namibia. Its mission is to be the source of local, regional, and world news in real-time.

feeds.title: The Namibian
feeds.description: The Namibian aims to grow its position as the largestNational daily newspaper, to maintain and develop its traditions of editorial independence and serve the Namibian people through high-quality news and information.

feeds.title: Republikein
feeds.description: Republikein brings you news and daily updates on topics like culture, business, environment, economy, sports, life, entertainment, and more.

feeds.title: Namibian Sun
feeds.description: Read news and analysis, local and global updates, business ideas, crime and investigations, culture and entertainment, and more on Namibian Sun.

feeds.title: Allgemeine Zeitung
feeds.description: The Allgemeine Zeitung (AZ) has existed since 1916 and is the oldest daily newspaper in Namibia. It has been published every day since the early 1930s. Read articles on Sports, Local, Nature & Environment, Business, and more.

feeds.title: NBC News
feeds.description: News making headlines in, around Namibia and beyond! The Namibian Broadcasting Corporation (NBC) endeavors to be a leading multi-media public broadcaster of choice in Africa and beyond.
